conviction_note: Near non-result. The Q3 KPI beat (GBV $437m against a $390-397m guide) is already public and points to Platform revenue slightly above guide. Solutions is ~62% of revenue, is set against a $5.1m Q3 2025 comp, and the October release pointedly hedged on it, which leans the other way. Q4 breakeven and an air-rate tailwind are the upside on the guide. Net impact_sum -0.70 with p_up 49 and abs_move 14 gives -0.28. The two measurements agree on 'close to zero, large unsigned move'.
bar: Company Q3 2026 guide: revenue $7.7-7.8m, adj. EBITDA $(1.3)-$(1.2)m, given 2026-08-17 (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/freightos-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-302852762.html). The consensus sits at or above the top of the guide. Two analysts (Craig-Hallum's George Sutton on the call; Freedom Broker, PT $2.50).

findings.finding: Q3 KPIs, pre-released 2026-10-15: GBV $437m (+30% YoY) against a company guide of $390-397m, ~11% above the top of the range; transactions 494k (+15%) against 481-490k. Platform revenue (Q2 $2.9m, +19%; Q3 2025 $2.6m) therefore likely prints ~$3.0-3.1m, at or above what the $7.7-7.8m revenue guide embedded. The release adds that 'GBV also reflected elevated freight rates', so part of the GBV beat is price, not take.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Same setup twice. Q2 2026: KPI beat pre-released, revenue $7.7m beat the $7.2-7.4m guide, shares +14% pre-market (https://finviz.com/news/382895/freightos-shares-surge-14-as-q2-loss-beats-expectations). Q3 2025: KPI beat pre-released, revenue lagged estimates, stock -13.9% on the day (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CRGO/freightos-reports-third-quarter-2025-y3crjr4vg07w.html). The KPI beat alone has not decided the sign.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the KPIs have been public for five weeks, the stock has since fallen below $1 (Nasdaq notice) and rebounded to $0.80. What is not public is the translation into Platform revenue. If the market had fully priced a Platform beat, the stock would not sit at a ~0.7x EV/sales low.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 precedent: the KPI beat translated into a revenue beat (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/freightos-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-302852762.html). Same company, different quarter.

findings.finding: Solutions (software/data, ~62% of revenue: $19.6m of $29.5m in FY2025) is the swing line and looks soft. It was $4.8m in Q1 and $4.8m in Q2 2026 (Q2 -4% YoY, 'SaaS performance weaker than expected', 'renewal pricing pressure', insufficient new bookings), against a Q3 2025 comp of $5.1m, so a flat sequential print is ~-6% YoY. The Oct-15 KPI release also changed its wording: from July's 'Solutions progress will be discussed in the upcoming earnings release' to 'Solutions, which account for the majority of Freightos' revenue, are less directly reflected in these metrics. The Company will provide an update on Solutions performance'. That reads as a hedge. Net of Platform at ~$3.0-3.1m, total revenue reaches the $7.83-7.90m consensus only if Solutions is >= ~$4.8m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: revenue lagged estimates while KPIs beat, stock -13.9%. Q4 2025 (2026-02-23): -30%, conflated with the founder's board exit (https://www.freightwaves.com/news/freightos-stock-plummets-after-founder-resigns). Q2 2026: Solutions -4% was offset by a Platform/Clearit beat, +14%.
findings.why_not_priced: The street consensus ($7.83m Aug; $7.90m on Chartmill) sits at or above the top of the $7.7-7.8m guide. That implies Solutions is modelled at or above the Q2 level despite the Q3 2025 comp and the hedge. If the market had priced a Solutions decline, consensus would sit at or below the guide midpoint.
findings.independence: Q2 call (TradingKey transcript, 2026-08-17): Solutions down on renewal pricing pressure, pipeline +30% QoQ, conversion 'to begin improving in H2' (https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262112964-tradingkey). Q3 2025 Solutions $5.1m from https://www.stocktitan.net/news/CRGO/freightos-reports-third-quarter-2025-y3crjr4vg07w.html. Inference from wording plus a comp; no direct Solutions data point.

findings.finding: The freight-rate backdrop since the guide was set is stronger, which supports a Q4/FY GBV raise. The guide 'assumes freight price levels and market volumes as of August 2026'. WorldACD global air rates were $3.45/kg in week 45 (2-8 Nov 2026), +31% YoY; late-October spot was reported +38% YoY. Tonnage was flat to down. Platform revenue tracks transactions more than rates (Q3 2025: GBV +54%, Platform +15%), so the transmission to revenue is weak.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent. The Q2 2026 call kept FY GBV +19-21% after a Q2 GBV beat, and the stock rose +14% on the revenue/EBITDA beat, not on GBV.
findings.why_not_priced: A sub-$1 microcap with two analysts and ~$70k/day of turnover; no one re-cuts a GBV guide from WorldACD. If priced, the stock would have rallied with the rate data rather than hitting a 52w low in early November.
findings.independence: Company's own Oct-15 release: 'GBV also reflected elevated freight rates amid tight capacity and higher fuel costs' (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/freightos-reports-platform-kpis-for-third-quarter-exceeding-management-expectations-302909936.html). Macro proxy; no direct confirmation of Q4 bookings.

findings.finding: Q4 2026 is the guided EBITDA-breakeven quarter. Guide: Q4 adj. EBITDA loss under $1m, crossing breakeven 'at some point during Q4', with the full impact of the March cost actions landing in Q4. Q2 liquidity was $21.4m (cash $13.3m plus $8.1m deposit) with burn tracking adj. EBITDA, and management said no financing is needed. Q3-end liquidity should therefore be ~$20m against a ~$41.7m market cap. A reaffirmation on the call lands on the guide and the cash path. The money question (lesson 4) was answered: no raise is planned, so it is not a negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: 'lowest-ever adj. EBITDA loss' plus reiterated breakeven, +14% pre-market. FY2025 print (Feb 2026): breakeven reiterated, but the stock fell -30% on the founder's exit.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely public. What is unseen is whether Q3 EBITDA beats $(1.2)m and Q4 is reaffirmed. An EV of ~$22m on ~$30m of revenue says the market doubts the path; if it believed it, EV/sales would not sit near 0.7x.
findings.independence: Q2 release figures (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/freightos-reports-second-quarter-2026-results-302852762.html), which share the Q2 document with the transcript.

findings.finding: Nasdaq minimum-bid deficiency notice dated 2026-11-10 (below $1 from 9 Sep to 9 Nov; cure by 2027-05-10). The company said it is weighing options 'including a possible reverse share split'. A reverse-split plan or an added AGM item could surface with results or on the call, which is typically a negative for a sub-$1 microcap.
findings.why_not_priced: The notice is public. Whether a split is announced in the window is uncertain, and the AGM proxy (filed Nov 4) shows no split item per FreightWaves' summary. If the market expected an imminent split, the stock would not have rallied +10% the day the notice came out.

outside_window.finding: Proxy fight: founder Zvi Schreiber (~6%) seeks the removal of Chairman Udo Lange, annual director elections and a Platform-first strategy, and alleges the proxy card was 'rigged'. The vote is at the AGM on 2026-12-16; the board opposes all three proposals. The call may draw questions, but the vote resolves after the window.

baseline_tension: No skew and no option chain. The stock is -75% from its high but +8% over 20 days off a 52w low, so the KPI-led optimism is partly back in the price, while the Solutions hedge and the consensus above the guide leave room for a Q3-2025-style sell-off. The evidence is balanced, hence p_up 49.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 / core table: the KPI-beat finding sits on a pre-released line that this name has both rewarded (+14%) and sold (-13.9%), so 1.0 -> 0.5
Lesson 5: the air-rate tailwind is macro-to-company transmission, confirmed only qualitatively by the company, so 0.8 -> 0.5
Lesson 4: financing was asked as a question; no raise is planned, so the cash finding stays a small positive, trimmed 0.5 -> 0.3 because the Q2 statement is already public
Lesson 6: the bar is sourced to the company guide; the two consensus figures disagree slightly and both sit at or above the top of the guide, as stated in bar
Lesson 8: thin coverage (2 analysts) and no options, so abs_move 13 -> 14; p_up 53 -> 49 after the size cuts left the set mildly negative
Lesson 9: the Solutions finding is already netted against the expected Platform beat; left at -1.5
